svg.text: Dotnet · D01 · Value vs reference — boxing is an allocation
Copy the bits, or copy the arrow.
int copies. A class name shares the object.
int to object (or interface) allocates a box.
Boxing is an allocation, not a cast
Hot loop + List<object> silently boxes every Add.
List<object> boxes every int you Add.
Small, immutable, value semantics — else class.
Struct only when copy is cheap
Name boxing with evidence, not slogans.
